facts: A method for error correction of ill-formed input is described.
A described method acquires dialogue patterns in typical usage.
A described method uses acquired dialogue patterns to predict new inputs.
Error correction is done by strongly biasing parsing toward expected meanings.
Clear evidence from the input can show the current sentence is not expected.
A dialogue acquisition and tracking algorithm is presented.
A description of the implementation of a dialogue acquisition and tracking algorithm in a voice interactive system is presented.
The implementation of a dialogue acquisition and tracking algorithm is in a voice interactive system.
A series of tests are described.
The described tests show the power of the error correction methodology.
The power of the error correction methodology is shown when stereotypic dialogue occurs.
A described method predicts new inputs.
There is error correction of ill-formed input.
